title: Semantic Assessor Output Schema
description: LLM-only discussion-state detector output. The detector assesses all eight semantic factors at every checkpoint; no hand-engineered feature or Candidate Gate is used. Each present factor carries a 0-1 LLM strength and exact transcript evidence. EvidenceChecker verifies citations before deterministic role classification.

evidenceRelations.description: Delibra spec §3 Node 3: per-message evidence-relations tracking. Each entry records which of the 6 states (mentioned / attributed / evaluated / compared / countered / integrated) the evidence in that message is in. Required: present but may be empty if no participant message has been evidence-tracked yet (early checkpoints). Stored on AgentState.checkpoint.evidenceRelations and used by the Controller to drive role decisions (e.g. 'mentioned but not compared' → Synthesiser). Verified by EvidenceChecker.js for valid messageIds.

factor.description: 单个语义因子的判断结果。

status.description: present=该因子在当前讨论中确实存在；absent=不存在；uncertain=证据不足以判断，不得因为'不确定'就默认为present。

message_ids.description: 支撑该判断的消息ID列表；仅在status='present'时必填。

span.description: 支撑该判断的原文引用（逐字，不得改写或概括）；仅在status='present'时必填。EvidenceChecker.js会核验这段文字是否真的出现在transcript中。

evidenceRelation.description: Delibra spec §3 Node 3: 追踪公开证据是否被 mentioned / attributed / evaluated / compared / countered / integrated. 每个 messageId 一条；不在关系判断范围内的消息可以省略。

messageId.description: the participant message whose evidence is being tracked. Must be one of the message IDs supplied with the public discussion.

mentioned.description: true 表示该 message 的 evidence 在讨论中被任一参与者提到（引用、复述、暗示）。

attributed.description: true 表示 evidence 被明确归因到某个选项 / 标准 / 立场（'X says Y about Z'、'the data shows ...'）。

evaluated.description: true 表示 evidence 被评估了可信度 / 相关性 / 充分性（'this is convincing', 'we should question ...', 'this doesn't address ...'）。

compared.description: true 表示 evidence 跟其他证据 / 选项 / 立场进行了显式比较（'X vs Y', 'unlike Z, this ...'）。

countered.description: true 表示有反证 / 反驳针对该 evidence（'but actually', 'this contradicts ...'）。

integrated.description: true 表示该 evidence 已经被纳入小组的最终判断 / 共识 / 决策中（'we'll go with X based on this'）。
